components.stateBoundary: Figma Focus and Dragging are visual specimens, not extra writable QDial properties. QDial wrapping is an independent native Q_PROPERTY; inherited sliderDown and focus/keyboard behavior require runtime verification.

Figma Hover and Dragging are visual specimens, not a standalone Qt state enum. QAbstractSlider sliderDown and QWidget enabled remain runtime behavior; QStyle subcontrols, keyboard and RTL require separate verification.
